author: Kushal
problem: Read N and K and then N strings of distinct lowercase letters. Choose any subset of the strings and print the largest possible number of letters that appear in exactly K of the chosen strings.
bug_description: Uses value >= K instead of value == K, so letters appearing in more than K chosen strings are counted too.

comments.accurate: Tries every subset of strings and keeps the most letters that occur in exactly K of them
comments.wrong_behavior: Tries every subset of strings and keeps the most letters that occur in at least K of them
comments.wrong_location: Letter-count threshold verified; check that the bitmask selects strings in the right order
